data.name: Ezaz

in_arabic.name: عزاز
in_arabic.meaning: يعني عز وجلال وقوة ورفعة في اللغة العربية

in_urdu.name: عزاز
in_urdu.meaning: عز وجلال وقوت اور عظمت کا مطلب ہے اردو میں
in_urdu.long_meaning: عزاز نام عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے عزت، جلال، قوت اور عظمت۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں گہری روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے اور تاریخی طور پر اہم ہے۔

in_hindi.name: عزاز
in_hindi.meaning: عزت و جلال و طاقت اور رفعت کا مطلب ہے
in_hindi.long_meaning: عزاز نام عربی मूल का है और इसका अर्थ है सम्मान, महिमा, शक्ति और उत्कृष्टता। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्वपूर्ण है और इसकी गहरी आध्यात्मिक महत्ता है।

in_pashto.name: عزاز
in_pashto.meaning: د عزت، جلال او ځواک معنی په پښتو کې
in_pashto.long_meaning: عزاز نوم د عربی له ريښو څخه اخیستل شوی دی او معنی یې د عزت، جلال او ځواک دی. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو او کلتور کې مهم دی.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ezaz carries a sense of power and strength, reflecting the importance of these qualities in various aspects of Islamic and Arabic culture. In Islamic literature, Ezaz is a significant figure, representing the strength and power of angels and their role in maintaining the balance and order in the universe.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ezaz highlights the significance of seeking and cultivating inner strength and empowerment as a means of drawing closer to Allah (God) and living a more fulfilling and purposeful life according to Islamic teachings. It reminds us that Allah is a source of endless strength and support, and that we can draw upon His power and guidance in times of need and challenge. Moreover, it encourages us to be steadfast and patient in our faith, to persevere in the face of adversity, and to strive towards self-improvement and personal growth, knowing that Allah is with us every step of the way.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Asakir records the name Ezaz as one of the prominent scholars and leaders of the people of Damascus during the early Umayyad period. He was a notable companion of Caliph Muawiya I and played a significant role in the administration and military of the Umayyad Caliphate.
historical_references.context: Damascus, Syria, Caliphate administration and military

historical_references.reference: Al-Bukhari and Muslim record that Ezaz was one of the companions of Prophet Muhammad who narrated a Hadith regarding the virtues of fasting during the month of Ramadan. This Hadith emphasizes the importance of sincere intention during fasting and seeking closeness to Allah.
